title: stenogyne waimeana
intro: Stenogyne waimeana, commonly known as Hawaiian mountain mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, particularly in its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Stenogyne waimeana include its ability to act as an antioxidant and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in wound healing and the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
